headline: DC urges MCM to prioritise local contractors for deals
summary: Mufulira District Commissioner Evaristo Chilumba called on Mopani Copper Mines to prioritise local contractors so residents benefit directly from mining operations. The call was made at a chamber of commerce meeting.
why: Mopani Copper Mines operates copper mining in Zambia, and local content policies can affect operating costs and community relations at mines.
